coldDefinition: Freshly linked selected image generation, fresh inode/path, fresh process and GERBIL_PATH; first-use versus immediate repeat. UUID/content identity measured, not assumed fresh. Runtime/OS caches and remote observer state uncontrolled; no globally cold claim. Common library files reused. Builds finish before timing.
compiler: Full configured installed gambuild-C options, identical generated C and objects for every matrix cell.
observer: Same passive observer all matrix samples; real dlopen/dlclose exactly once; monotonic API duration. Unobserved original-launcher checks separately.
analysis: Retain every scheduled result. Paired packing differences within import scope and block; paired import differences within packaging and block; first/repeat differences. No pooled cross-block causal ratio; no whole-host SLA.
hashing: Input byte hashes before/after outside timed process; cache effects disclosed. No cache purge.
cellIsolation: Each cell and block has separately linked image paths and inodes; no first-use cell reuses selected-image aliases from another cell. Common runtime and nonselected libraries remain shared.
